question: Does the installed standard Swift 1.5 Qwen3.8-27B IQ2_XS profile pass a fixed coding screen materially better than the configured ASTRA Flash-Next IQ2_XS profile on both RTX 3090 GPUs with 128 GB RAM, tested serially?

hardware.ram: 128 GB host RAM, available to both arms without MemoryMax/MemoryHigh caps
hardware.gpuMode: Both GPUs are mandatory for each arm; no single-GPU arm.
hardware.concurrency: One model server and one request at a time; ASTRA completes and cleans up before Swift starts.

control.name: ASTRA configured default · Qwen3.8 Flash-Next IQ2_XS

candidate.name: Swift 1.5 Qwen3.8-27B IQ2_XS standard GGUF, no MTP

matchedParameters.grader: Q72 pinned bubblewrap/seccomp; deny network; 45 s timeout

supervisor.type: transient systemd user service with AppArmorProfile=chatgpt; no persistent unit or autostart
supervisor.reason: Q94 replayed Q91/Q93 against ASTRA historical Q14 guard: the Q91/Q93 full>=20% ×30s threshold stopped at 51–52% PSI despite 92–101 GiB available and zero OOM, while the previously used full>=60% or some>=80% ×15s guard would not stop the captured samples. Moderate PSI is therefore a warning; severe PSI retains a hard stop. No host memory caps or persistent settings.
supervisor.apparmorProfile: chatgpt (pre-existing profile; no host policy change; Q96 no-op smoke 2/2)

gates.preflight: Both GPUs visible and are RTX 3090; target ports free; no external inference server; MemAvailable >=32 GiB; baseline global memory PSI some/full avg10 <5%; no new cgroup memory OOM events.
duringRun: any global or service-cgroup OOM/oom_kill increment (hard stop)
global memory PSI full avg10 >=60% for 15 consecutive 1-second samples (severe stop)
global memory PSI some avg10 >=80% for 15 consecutive 1-second samples (severe stop)
global memory PSI full avg10 >=20% or some avg10 >=70% for 30 consecutive samples is a warning only; record and continue while hard gates pass
service-cgroup memory PSI is sampled independently and recorded; it is diagnostic, not a stop gate until calibrated against a matched run
server, transport, sandbox or cleanup failure
owned model process not visible on both GPU0 and GPU1 after readiness
systemd transient service exits or reaches RuntimeMaxSec
gates.candidateToRepeat: Swift >=3/8 and >=2 more passes than ASTRA, transport 8/8 per arm, sandboxErrors=0.
gates.speed: No speed claim. New balanced >=3-seed preregistration required; quality non-inferior and >=10% median correct-result E2E improvement.

memoryPressurePolicy.moderateWarning: global some>=70% or full>=20% for 30 consecutive 1-second samples; do not abort
memoryPressurePolicy.severeStop: global full>=60% or some>=80% for 15 consecutive 1-second samples
memoryPressurePolicy.cgroupPsi: sample full/some avg10 and log; no gate until separately calibrated
memoryPressurePolicy.hardStops: MemAvailable<32 GiB; global oom_kill or service-cgroup oom/oom_kill increments

limitations: Profile-level comparison; runtime, MTP/speculation and templates differ.
Both profiles run at context 8192; this does not measure 1M or 262144-token context.
A stop gate produces N/D, not 0/8.

amendments.change: Run the transient user service with AppArmorProfile=chatgpt, the already-existing caller profile. Q96 validated both Bubblewrap no-op shapes in that service context.

calibrationBasis.observed: Q14 and Q35 completed ASTRA 1M with about 51 GiB RSS and at least 55.64 GiB available. Q91/Q93 reached global PSI full avg10 51.48%/52.34%, MemAvailable minima 101.014/92.073 GiB, OOM=0, and were stopped by full>=20% for 30s.
calibrationBasis.change: Keep hard MemAvailable<32 GiB and any OOM. Treat PSI full>=20% or some>=70% sustained as a warning, and stop only at full>=60% or some>=80% for 15 consecutive 1s samples, reproducing Q14 calibration. Record both global and service-cgroup PSI.
calibrationBasis.interpretation: PSI reports memory stalls; by itself it is not a crash predictor. The diagnostic cgroup PSI has no stop threshold yet because Q14/Q35 receipts do not provide a matching service-cgroup series.

preflight.reason: Q97 must verify current file fingerprints and host state before any model is loaded.
